blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Senate impeachment court received on Wednesday documents on Vice President Sara Duterte and her husband Atty. Manases Carpio’s properties in Davao City. This comes as defense witness, Davao City Assessor Engr. Jaime Adelin submitted to the court the records asked of him. “We would like to inform the senator-Judges, particularly Senator-judge [Bam] Aquino and [Risa] Hontiveros, that the court is in receipt via email of copies of… certification of records regarding properties declared for tax purposes under the names of Vice President Sara Duterte and Manases Carpio,” presiding officer Francis “Chiz” Escudero announced.
